title: 2-Bus Radial Distribution Feeder Power Flow
description: Minimal 12.47 kV three-phase radial distribution feeder with a voltage source, overhead line segment, and balanced constant-power load.
code:
! 2-Bus Radial Distribution Feeder (12.47 kV)
Clear

New Circuit.Radial2Bus basekv=12.47 pu=1.02 phases=3 bus1=SourceBus

New LineCode.OH_336ACSR nphases=3 r1=0.190 x1=0.390 r0=0.450 x0=1.220 units=km
New Line.FeederMain bus1=SourceBus bus2=LoadBus1 phases=3 linecode=OH_336ACSR length=3.2

New Load.CommercialLoad bus1=LoadBus1 phases=3 kv=12.47 kw=1500 kvar=480

Set VoltageBases = [12.47]
CalcVoltageBases
Solve
